home.title: 7th International WriteTec Congress on Social and Health Sciences in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
home.theme: Main Theme: Social and Health Sciences in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
home.dates: August 28 – September 2, 2026 · ANTALYA / ALANYA · In-person + Online
home.pubBook: Publication as a chapter in edited international publishers (including BKCI)
home.aboutTitle: 7th International WRITETEC Congress on Social and Health Sciences in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
home.aboutP1: Humanity's body of knowledge gains meaning at the intersection of social sciences' deep understanding of society and health sciences' power to protect life. Today, the most powerful force carrying these two great fields into the future is the transformative impact of artificial intelligence.
home.aboutP2: Artificial intelligence offers new possibilities across a wide spectrum — from understanding human behavior, social trends and large-scale data in social sciences to improving diagnosis, treatment and public health processes in health sciences. As boundaries between disciplines blur, a culture of collaborative work becomes ever more valuable.
home.aboutP3: Methods such as natural language processing, machine learning and data analytics are expanding the scope and impact of research in many fields, from education to economics, psychology to public administration, nursing to public health. These are no longer the science of the future, but the scientific reality of today.
home.aboutP4: At WriteTec, we believe that artificial intelligence is one of the greatest forces in solving societal problems and ensuring equal opportunity in health. When used correctly, ethically and responsibly, it democratizes access to knowledge and accelerates scientific production.
home.aboutP5: This congress aims to bring together scientists, clinicians, researchers and practitioners working at the intersection of social sciences, health sciences and artificial intelligence. Through papers, panels and sessions, we will discuss the innovations brought by artificial intelligence, address our ethical responsibilities, and chart a common roadmap for a better future.
home.aboutP6: Be part of this collective effort. Take your place on this unique platform where science, technology and humanity meet. Because a better future is only possible through knowledge produced together.
home.quote: "In the age of artificial intelligence, knowledge is a shared value that multiplies when shared and grows stronger as disciplines unite."
home.closing1: We believe that the work to be done at the congress will inspire future research, and we would be delighted to have you share your expertise and experience with us. With these sentiments, we express our great pleasure in welcoming you to our congress and extend our respects.

konular.title: Congress Topics
konular.frameBody: Our congress primarily features studies at the intersection of research, practice, education and policy in social sciences and health sciences with artificial intelligence.
konular.healthTitle: SOCIAL SCIENCES AND HEALTH SCIENCES (EXAMPLE FIELDS):
konular.healthBody: Within social sciences: educational sciences, psychology, sociology, economics and business, public administration, communication, law, history, language and literature, theology and philosophy; within health sciences: main branches of medicine, nursing, midwifery, dentistry, pharmacy, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, nutrition and dietetics, public health, health management, occupational health and safety, and related multidisciplinary fields. Original studies that do not use artificial intelligence may also be considered for evaluation provided the abstract is suitable.
konular.aiBody: Decision support systems; text and image analysis; natural language processing; data privacy and security; explainable artificial intelligence; generative AI tools and ethical principles; digital transformation applications; and machine learning / deep learning methods.
konular.interBody: Interdisciplinary papers directly related to ethics and law, economy and policy, education and society, health service delivery, and societal or individual outcomes are accepted within the congress framework.

yukselmeTesvik.title: Academic Promotion, Incentive and Professorship Information
yukselmeTesvik.intro: According to CoHE regulations, our congress is of international character. It meets the criteria used for appointments to faculty positions. Official assignment letters from the congress organizing committee required for professorship applications will be added to the congress e-book after the congress.
yukselmeTesvik.incentiveBody: According to YÖK academic incentive regulations, for an international congress to meet academic incentive requirements, more than half of the submitted papers must be from outside Turkey and participation from at least 5 countries (excluding Turkey) must be ensured. A 40% quota has been allocated for Turkey within our congress. Applications from Turkey will be evaluated while preserving this quota. Our congress is also expected to meet the academic incentive conditions.
yukselmeTesvik.evalLi1: Scientific works submitted to our congress must be unpublished and must not have been published or evaluated elsewhere as oral or poster presentations.
yukselmeTesvik.evalLi2: Abstracts submitted to our congress undergo a double-blind peer review process. Abstracts accepted as a result of peer review are included in the congress program.
yukselmeTesvik.evalLi3: Our congress scientific board includes scientists from different countries.
yukselmeTesvik.evalLi4: After the congress, an ISBN-numbered congress e-proceedings book is published.

kayitBilgisi.title: Congress Registration Fee Information
kayitBilgisi.note1: The participation fee includes publication of abstracts and full texts in the ISBN e-proceedings book. Prices include VAT. The congress registration fee is separate from the accommodation fee; for accommodation details, please see the Congress Accommodation Information page.
kayitBilgisi.accountsTitle: Account Information for Congress Registration Fee
kayitBilgisi.accountTry: Account Information for Turkish Lira Payments
kayitBilgisi.onlineP1: The participation fee covers only the presenting author. Other authors and guests from outside the congress must pay the external participant fee if they attend the congress. We would appreciate our congress participants' sensitivity on this matter.
kayitBilgisi.onlineP2: Participants must deposit the participation fee to the specified account number by the registration deadline at the latest, and send the receipt to writetecbt@gmail.com.
kayitBilgisi.cancelP1Before: If a cancellation request is submitted by the registration deadline, 50% of the participation fee paid will be refunded.
kayitBilgisi.cancelP1After: For cancellation requests submitted after the final registration date announced in the congress calendar, 10% of the participation fee paid will be refunded.
kayitBilgisi.onlineP3: To avoid any hardship on either side, we kindly ask our valued participants to pay maximum attention to the matters stated above.
kayitBilgisi.onlineP4: For master's and doctoral students who receive an acceptance letter but do not complete registration or do not attend the congress for any reason, a "Acceptance Letter Cancellation Letter" is sent to their affiliated institute.
kayitBilgisi.importantNote: IMPORTANT NOTE: Accepted papers must be presented at the congress (in person or online). Participation certificates will not be issued and papers will not be included in the congress proceedings book for papers that are not presented.

bildiriYukleme.title: Paper Submission
bildiriYukleme.introBefore: After the congress you can upload your abstract or full-text paper as a Word (.docx) document. Your submission is added automatically to the congress
bildiriYukleme.introAfter: , and a confirmation e-mail is sent to all authors once the process is complete.
bildiriYukleme.formHint: Click the button below to open the paper submission form and upload your document.
bildiriYukleme.ruleType: You may upload either an abstract or a full-text paper; the type is selected within the form.
bildiriYukleme.ruleFormat: Only .docx documents are accepted (max 20 MB). Figures and tables must be embedded in the document.
bildiriYukleme.ruleMail: Once your paper is added to the proceedings book, a confirmation e-mail is sent to every author listed on the form.
bildiriYukleme.contactHint: You can reach us by e-mail or WhatsApp for your questions.

odemeBildirimi.formHint: Click the button below to open the form and submit your payment notification with your reference number and receipt.
odemeBildirimi.ruleRef: Your reference number is in your acceptance e-mail (it starts with WT-); matching is done using this number.

odemeBildirimi.ruleApprove: Once your receipt is reviewed and approved, you will receive a confirmation e-mail that your registration is finalized.

katilimKurallari.title: Participation Rules
katilimKurallari.intro: Academics, undergraduate, master's and doctoral students, researchers, NGO representatives, company representatives and parties related to the congress topic from Turkey and abroad may participate in the congress.
katilimKurallari.rule1: The congress languages are Turkish and English.
katilimKurallari.rule2: Participation in the congress is available to present an oral paper. It is also possible to attend the congress as an external participant without presenting a paper.
katilimKurallari.rule3: Participants whose papers are accepted at the congress and external participants are deemed to have agreed to comply with the decisions of the congress organizing committee, the congress calendar and cancellation terms.
katilimKurallari.rule4: Scientific works submitted to our congress must be unpublished and must not have been published or evaluated elsewhere as oral or poster presentations.
katilimKurallari.rule5: Abstracts submitted to our congress undergo a double-blind peer review process. Abstracts accepted as a result of peer review are included in the congress program.
katilimKurallari.rule6Before: Abstracts must be prepared in accordance with the fields and rules specified in the
katilimKurallari.rule6After: and submitted through the application form.
katilimKurallari.rule7: After the congress, papers presented by participants are published according to the participant's publication preference.
katilimKurallari.rule8: Those who receive an acceptance letter but do not complete registration or do not attend the congress for any reason are not issued a participation certificate and cannot be included in the e-proceedings book.
katilimKurallari.rule9: For master's and doctoral students who receive an acceptance letter but do not complete registration or do not attend the congress for any reason, an "Acceptance Letter Cancellation Letter" is sent to their affiliated institute.
katilimKurallari.rule10: Participants may attend the congress with a maximum of 2 papers.
